'''Molvar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], leading the twelve-man [[Alpha Squad (Quesh)|Alpha Squad]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]]. Molvar had a [[Molvar's cousin|cousin]] who became a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] but [[Death/Legends|died]] young. Molvar's squad was wiped out by [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenal]]-using [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] defenders, and Molvar only survived because he was knocked unconscious by a [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] and suffered six broken ribs, a shattered kneecap, and a severe concussion. He later asked a fellow Imperial to finish his mission.
